title: This island changes country every six months
description:
Pheasant Island, a 200-metre island in the Bidasoa river, is Spanish from February to July and French from August to January.

Sources:
- Pheasant Island — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pheasant_Island
- Spanish or French? Pheasant Island is about to swap nationalities — again — Euronews (Inês Trindade Pereira, 30 July 2024): https://www.euronews.com/2024/07/30/spanish-or-french-pheasant-island-is-about-to-swap-nationalities-again
- The little Spanish town that found itself in France — CNN Travel: https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/llivia-spain-france
- Treaty of the Pyrenees — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treaty_of_the_Pyrenees
